## 2. Detailed Service Breakdown

### 01. Graphic Design
Bold, modern visuals that command attention across digital and print surfaces — including campaign visuals, posters, promotional graphics, deck design, and marketing collateral.

### 02. Video Editing
Cinematic cuts, rhythm, and pacing built to hold viewer attention. Covers long-form YouTube videos, retention-focused storytelling, Shorts/Reels/TikTok vertical edits, commercial spots, and color grading in DaVinci Resolve.

### 03. Social Media Design
Scroll-stopping creatives engineered for social feeds — Instagram carousels, LinkedIn visual posts, launch announcements, and paid social ad creatives.

### 04. Branding & Visual Identity
Cohesive identity systems with a distinct voice and lasting recall — logomarks, typography systems, color palettes, and brand guidelines for startups and creators.

### 05. Thumbnail Design
High-CTR YouTube and video thumbnails crafted around visual hierarchy, curiosity gaps, and facial/subject contrast to drive clicks and watch time.

### 06. Motion Graphics
Animated typography, kinetic titles, logo reveals, UI motion, and visual effects crafted in Adobe After Effects to bring stories to life.
